source_file.Description: NWB file in sourcedata/ (date in the name masked to day 01) that the recording was converted from.

recording_month.Description: Year and month of the session (NWB session_start_time; day withheld).

source_rate_attribute.Description: The 'rate' attribute stored in the NWB (n/a when explicit timestamps are stored); often wrong, see README.

sampling_frequency_used.Description: Sampling frequency used for this recording (evidence in README).
